function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
Here’s a concise overview of key Texas traffic laws and regulations that drivers should know: | Topic | Key Points | Practical Tips | |-------|------------|----------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 70 mph on some urban interstates, 45 mph on most rural highways.
• 25 mph in school zones during school hours. | • Always obey posted signs; use a GPS that updates speed limits. | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑seat Requirements** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 4 must be in a rear‑facing car seat.
• Children 4–7 must be in a forward‑facing seat with a harness.
• Children 8–12 must be in a booster seat. | • Check the seat‑belt sign on the dashboard; it turns green when all occupants are buckled. | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use is illegal while driving.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | • Use voice‑activated controls or a Bluetooth headset. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08 % or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | • Designate a sober driver or use rideshare services if you’ve been drinking. | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and yield at yield signs.
• At uncontrolled intersections, give right‑of‑way to vehicles approaching from the right. | • Keep a safe following distance; use the “two‑second rule.” | | **School Bus Laws** | • Stop for a school bus with its stop sign extended and lights flashing.
• Vehicles traveling in either direction must stop. | • Stay alert for school buses; they may stop on both sides of the road. | | **Lane‑Changing & Passing** | • Use turn signals at least 100 ft before changing lanes.
• Do not pass on the right unless the vehicle ahead is turning left. | • Check mirrors and blind spots before moving. | | **Traffic Signal Timing** | • Red light: stop until the light turns green.
• Yellow light: proceed if you’re already in the intersection; otherwise stop. | • Avoid “red‑light running” by planning your approach to intersections. | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a stop sign, crosswalk, or intersection.
• No parking on sidewalks or in front of driveways. | • Use designated parking zones; check for “no parking” signs. | | **Vehicle Inspection & Registration** | • Annual vehicle inspection required for most vehicles.
• Registration renewal due by the last day of the month indicated on your license plate. | • Keep inspection stickers and registration receipts in the vehicle. | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for bodily injury per accident, $25,000 for property damage. | • Maintain proof of insurance in the vehicle; carry a copy of your policy. | | **Special Situations** | • **Towing**: Must be done safely; use a tow strap or chain.
• **Emergency Vehicles**: Yield to police, ambulance, and fire trucks.
• **Construction Zones**: Follow detour signs and reduced speed limits. | • Slow down and follow detour routes; stay alert for workers. | ### Quick Reference Checklist for Drivers 1. **Seat belt** – All occupants buckled. 2. **Cell‑phone** – Hands‑free only. 3. **Speed limit** – Follow posted signs. 4. **Right‑of‑way** – Yield to pedestrians and stopped vehicles. 5. **School bus** – Stop for flashing lights. 6. **Parking** – No parking near intersections or on sidewalks. 7. **Insurance** – Proof in the vehicle. ### Resources | Resource | What It Offers | How to Access | |----------|----------------|---------------| | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | Vehicle registration, insurance verification, driver’s license info | https://www.txdmv.gov | | Texas Transportation Commission | Traffic safety statistics, enforcement data | https://www.txdot.gov | | Texas Highway Patrol | Enforcement tips, DUI resources | https://www.txdps.state.tx.us | | Texas DOT Traffic Safety | Road safety education, school bus rules | https://www.txdot.gov/ | Feel free to ask if you’d like more detail on any specific law or regulation!
